title: Curated SU(3) glueball masses relevant to the O(y^4) C-odd flat-band work
relevance: The work computes the C-odd T1^{+-} (=1^{+-}) one-flux band in the Kogut-Susskind strong-coupling Hamiltonian and finds it flat through O(y^3), lifting at O(y^4). The 1^{+-} row below is the physical glueball that band describes; the 0^{++}/2^{++} rows set the scale and cross-check the formalism.

scale_setting_Athenodorou_Teper.note: Authors also mention the traditional Regge value sqrt(sigma) ~ 440 MeV, but adopt 485(6) MeV via r0.

states.derivation: 3.405(21) x 485(6) MeV, errors added in quadrature

states.method: Monte Carlo in the Kogut-Susskind Hamiltonian limit (a_t->0)
Monte Carlo in the Kogut-Susskind Hamiltonian limit

states.comment: THE C-odd state the flat-band work describes. m/sqrt(sigma) ~ 2940/485 = 6.06.

cross_check: Hamiltonian-limit 0++ = 1654(83) MeV vs AT continuum 0++ = 1651(23) MeV: agree within errors, validating cross-formalism comparison.
